title.en: Withdrawing the Tax-Free Importation Privilege of the National Grains Authority Under Presidential Decree No. 726

text.en:
Section 1 of Presidential Decree No. 726 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. Any provision of law, order or regulation to the contrary notwithstanding, the National Grains
Authority (NGA) shall have the authority to determine and import exclusively, from whatever source abroad,
the annual wheat grain requirements of the country: Provided, That the NGA shall include wheat grain in its
total grains policy in coordination with the rice and corn policies: Provided, further, That the NGA shall have
the authority to negotiate, for and in behalf of the Republic of the Philippines, the importation of wheat grains
on a government-to-government basis; and Provided, finally, That the importation of wheat grains shall be
subject to customs duties, taxes and other charges."

Any provision of law, decree, order or regulation inconsistent or contrary with the provisions of
this decree are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This decree shall take effect upon its approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 4th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
